notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Freeze liability revolt
notable.line: Municipal utility operators in two member states refuse ENISA payment-freeze orders during a false-positive swarm alert, triggering a public dispute over liability for halted services.

notable.title: Municipal patch revolt
notable.line: Municipal utility operators in the two rollback regions publicly refuse further automated patching after legacy control failures, triggering coordinated resistance to ENISA-mandated updates.

notable.title: Patch rollback stall
notable.line: A coordinated municipal utility revolt pauses ENISA automated-patching rollout over safety false-positives, leaving uncertified grids exposed through winter.
